DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図で散歩の道をお探しですね。どの場所まで行くおつもりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking for a walking route on the map. How far do you intend to go?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この池までです。図では線が短いので近いと思いましたが、実際の距離をまだ見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 池への短い線を近いと思ったが実距離は未確認と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: To this pond. The line is short on the map so I thought it was close, but I have not checked the actual distance yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the short line to the pond looked close, but the actual distance is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 図の縮尺と、道の案内を一緒に確認しましょう。今日は長く歩きたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the map scale together with the route information. Do you want a long walk today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 長くは歩きたくありません。線の見た目だけで決めず、休んで戻れる距離を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 長く歩かず線の見た目でなく休んで戻れる距離を選びたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I want to choose a distance where I can rest and return, rather than deciding only from how the line looks.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you do not want a long walk and will choose a distance allowing a rest and return, rather than by the line's appearance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 途中の休憩地点も見ましょう。池まで行かなくても戻れる分岐が図にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us also look at rest points along the way. The map has a junction where you can turn back without reaching the pond.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この分岐までならどうか、案内の距離を読みます。休みたくなったら池を目指し続けず戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 分岐への距離を読み休みたい場合に池へ進まず戻ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will read the posted distance to see whether this junction would be suitable. If I want a rest, I would rather turn back than keep heading for the pond.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will read the distance to the junction and turn back rather than continue to the pond if you want a rest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 帰りの方向を図でたどっておきましょう。違う道で一周することも考えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us trace the return direction on the map first. Are you also considering a circuit using another path?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一周はせず、最初は同じ道を戻ります。別の道が短そうでも距離が分からないまま選ばないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一周せず同じ道を戻り別経路は距離不明のまま選ばない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not do a circuit; initially I will return along the same path. Even if another path looks short, I will not choose it without knowing the distance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Return along the same path without doing a circuit, and do not select an alternative of unknown distance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認しながら短く歩けますね。どなたかに池まで行くと伝えてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can have a short walk while checking. Have you told anyone you are going to the pond?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人にそう伝えました。案内を見て途中の往復へ変更するかを決め、決まった経路を知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 池予定を伝えた友人へ案内で途中往復にするかを確かめ決めた経路を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I told a friend. I will look at the guidance to decide whether to change to an out-and-back partway, then tell them the route I choose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the guidance to decide on a partway return and tell the chosen route to the friend already told of the pond plan. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、縮尺と距離の案内を見てからどうぞ。休みながら、よい散歩を楽しんでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please check the scale and distance information before setting off. Take breaks and enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 列車の案内が気になりますか。到着したい時刻があるようでしたら、お聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you concerned about the train information? Please tell me if there is a time you want to arrive.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 体験教室に行きます。列車が遅れているので、開始に間に合うか不安です。教室の案内は持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 教室の開始に間に合うか不安だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am going to a trial class. The train is delayed, so I am worried about making the start. I have the class information with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are worried about reaching the class before it starts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 開始時刻のほかに、受付について書かれていることはありますか。運行の見込みと、その条件を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Besides the start time, is anything written about check-in? Let us check the service forecast separately from those conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開始の十分前までに受付とあります。開始に間に合えばよいと思っていたので、もっと早い到着が必要だったのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 開始だけを到着期限と考えない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says to check in at least ten minutes before the start. I thought arriving by the start was enough, but I needed to arrive earlier.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not treat the starting time alone as the arrival deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その条件も主催者へ確認してください。こちらでは列車の見込みは案内できますが、遅れて参加できるかは決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please confirm that condition with the organizer too. We can provide train forecasts, but cannot decide whether late participation is allowed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 主催者に受付へ遅れる可能性を伝えます。列車を待つ場合の見込みと、ほかの移動案を調べることはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付条件と運行見込みを別に確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will tell the organizer I may be late for check-in. Can we check the forecast if I wait for the train, and other transport options?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check check-in conditions separately from service forecasts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 目的地への案を確認しましょう。ただ、別の手段が必ず早いとは言えません。所要時間と切符の条件も比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check options to the destination. However, another method is not necessarily faster. Please compare travel time and ticket conditions too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 慌てて別の手段へ変えず、かかる時間と費用を確かめます。主催者の回答も聞いてから、向かうか決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 急ぐだけで代替手段や参加を決めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not rush into changing transport; I will check the time and cost. I also want to hear the organizer's answer before deciding whether to go.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not choose alternative transport or participation simply out of haste. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お決めになる前に運行の更新をもう一度ご覧ください。教室側の返答と鉄道の案内は、別々にメモするとわかりやすいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please look once more at service updates before deciding. Keeping the class's reply and railway guidance in separate notes should help.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受付の可否は主催者、移動の見込みは案内で確認します。両方の回答を見て、参加の予定を伝え直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 教室側と交通側の確認を組み合わせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will confirm check-in eligibility with the organizer and travel forecasts in the transport information. After seeing both answers, I will update my participation plans.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Combine confirmation from the class and transport sides. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 主催者への確認と移動の確認を切り分けられましたね。運行の表示を確かめ、お気をつけてお出かけください。体験教室でよい時間を過ごせることを願っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have separated organizer confirmation from travel checks. Check the service display and travel safely. I hope you have a good time at the trial class.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談を希望されるのはご本人ですね。付き添いの方と一緒に来られる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are the person wishing to consult us. Are you planning to come with someone accompanying you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日本語を手伝ってくれる友人と来たいです。友人が話してくれれば、私の手続きも全部進められると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 付き添いが全部の手続きも行うと思ったと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to come with a friend who helps with Japanese. I thought if my friend spoke, all my procedures could be carried out too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Indicate that you thought your companion would also handle all procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 説明を手伝うことと、ご本人の代わりに手続きをすることは同じではありません。どんな用件か、まずご自身で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Helping explain and carrying out procedures on your behalf are different. First, please tell me yourself what the matter is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 届いた通知の内容を相談したいです。友人には難しい説明を聞くのを助けてもらい、私の希望は自分で伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通知相談で自分の希望を自分で伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to ask about a notice I received. My friend can help me understand difficult explanations, but I want to express my wishes myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State your wishes yourself when consulting about the notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その役割を担当者に伝えて、同行できる条件を確認しましょう。個人の情報が含まれる場合、誰にどこまで話すかも相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us tell the staff about that role and check the conditions for accompanying you. If personal information is involved, also discuss who may hear how much.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人が同席できるかを先に聞きます。通知を全部見せると決めず、私がわからない部分だけ相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人へ全通知を示す前に担当と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will first ask whether my friend can be present. I will not decide to show the whole notice; I want to ask only about the parts I do not understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check with staff before showing your friend the entire notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご希望をメモしておきましょう。日時を調整する際は、ご本人と友人の両方が来られる候補を示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us note your wishes. When arranging a date and time, suggest options when both you and your friend can come.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 火曜の午前なら二人とも空いています。友人の都合だけでなく、私もその時間に来られると確認しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人と友人の都合を確認した候補にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: We are both free on Tuesday morning. I checked not only my friend's availability but that I can come then too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose a proposed time after checking both your own and your friend's availability. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 候補の受付や予約が可能かは担当者の返答をお待ちください。友人が来られなくなった場合の相談方法も聞いておけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait for the staff's reply about whether check-in or reservation at that time is possible. You can also ask how to consult if your friend cannot come.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同行の条件と予約の返答を待ちます。友人が来られない場合の説明支援も尋ね、用件と私の希望をメモで持参します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 付き添いが来られなくても相談方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait for the accompaniment conditions and reservation answer. I will also ask about help understanding explanations if my friend cannot come, and bring notes about the matter and my wishes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about consultation methods even if your companion cannot come. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご自身と付き添いの役割が整理できましたね。通知とメモをご用意になり、日時が確認できましたらお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have clarified your own role and your companion's. Prepare the notice and notes, and come once the date and time have been confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帰りの前に書類のことでご相談でしょうか。どこへ提出するための物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to ask about documents before leaving? Where will you submit them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二つの職場へ提出します。一方は受診日がわかるもの、もう一方は休む期間がわかるものと言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受診日と休む期間の依頼を分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: To two workplaces. One asked for something showing the consultation date, and the other for something showing the period of leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain requests for the consultation date and leave period separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 求める内容が違うのですね。同じ書類でよいと判断する前に、それぞれの書類名や必要事項を確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: They require different information. Before deciding one document will do, let us check each document's name and required items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 領収書を二枚コピーすれば足りると思っていました。休む期間は領収書で説明できるか、職場に聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 休む期間の提出条件が未確認だと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought two photocopies of the receipt would be enough. I have not asked work whether the receipt can explain the leave period.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Indicate that the submission requirements for the leave period are unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 職場の条件は各提出先へ確認してください。期間についての判断や記載は、医療の担当者へ相談が必要な場合もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Check each workplace's requirements with the recipient. Decisions or wording about the period may also need consultation with medical staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で期間を書き足さず、どんな書類を申し込むか確認します。二か所の依頼文を窓口で見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要書類を窓口で確認して申し込む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not add the period myself; I will check which document to request. Can the counter look at the two workplaces' written requests?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check and request the necessary documents at the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類窓口で、それぞれの依頼を説明してご相談ください。私から、どの書類が発行できるかや費用を決めることはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain each request and consult at the document counter. I cannot decide which documents can be issued or their fees.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 必要な種類が決まったら、費用と受け取れる時期を聞きます。一か所の提出日が早いので、その期限も伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 早い提出先の条件を担当へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Once the required types are clear, I will ask the cost and when they can be collected. One submission date is early, so I also want to tell them that deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell the staff about the earlier recipient's requirements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 期限はお伝えください。ただし、その日までに受け取れるとは限りません。間に合わない場合の対応は提出先にも相談しておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell them the deadline. However, collection by then is not guaranteed. Also discuss with the recipient what to do if it is not ready in time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの職場へ名称と必要事項を確認し、依頼文と期限を分けて書類窓口へ示します。手元の領収書は保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 提出先確認と書類申込みと領収書保管を進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask both workplaces for the document names and required details, then show the requests and deadlines separately at the document counter. I will keep the receipt I have.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Proceed with checking recipients, applying for documents and keeping the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 提出先ごとの相談内容がはっきりしましたね。領収書と依頼文を忘れずにお持ちになって、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: The matters to discuss with each recipient are clear now. Do not forget your receipt and written requests, and take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: イヤホンの落とし物についてですね。ケースごとですか、それとも片方だけでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about a lost earphone. Was it the whole case, or just one side?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右の一個だけです。左と充電ケースは手元にあるので、なくした物を一組全部と伝えないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 左とケースを含む一組紛失と混同しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Just the right one. I still have the left and charging case, so I do not want to report that I lost the entire set.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Do not confuse this with losing the whole set including the left earphone and case. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 右側だけということで記録します。最後に両方あると確かめた場所は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will record that only the right side is missing. Do you remember the last place you confirmed you had both?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 喫茶店でケースから出したときは二つありました。帰り道で右を外したので、店で落としたとは言い切れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 喫茶店を紛失場所と断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Both were there when I took them out of the case at a café. I removed the right one on the way home, so I cannot say for certain I lost it at the café.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not identify the café as the definite loss location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: わかる範囲の経路も説明してください。なくした右側に、色や目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also describe the route as far as you know it. Does the lost right earphone have a color or distinguishing mark?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 白色で、右を表す文字の横に青い点をつけています。左にはその点がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 残る左とは異なる目印を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is white, and I put a blue dot beside the letter marking the right side. The left one has no dot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the mark that differs from the left earphone you still have. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その特徴を添えましょう。同じ製品の物でも、ご自身の物かは確認が必要です。購入情報などが残っていれば担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us add that feature. Even for the same product, ownership needs checking. If purchase information remains, please ask the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 箱は家に残っています。箱の情報が片方の照合に使えるか、見せる前に担当の方へ聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱があれば所有物と照合できると決めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I still have the box at home. Before showing it, I want to ask the staff whether its information can be used to match one earphone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not assume a box will establish ownership. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認に役立つ情報をご案内します。帰りに通った店など、すでに問い合わせた場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will advise what information helps verification. Have you already contacted any places, such as shops passed on your way home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 喫茶店には聞きましたが、なかったそうです。残る左とケースを持ち、右の青い点と歩いた道を説明して相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 特徴と経路で片方の相談を進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I asked the café, but they said it was not there. I will bring the remaining left earphone and case and explain the right one's blue dot and my route when consulting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Continue the inquiry about one earphone using its features and your route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 片方だけの紛失と確認済みの場所がわかりました。連絡の案内もお確かめになってお帰りください。見つかるとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We know it is only one side and which place has already been checked. Please also check the contact instructions before leaving. I hope it is found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票でのお受取りをお考えですね。いま荷物を持ち帰る予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are considering collecting an item using a missed-delivery notice. Were you planning to take the parcel home now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事帰りに歩いて持ち帰るつもりでした。でも差出人から重い箱だと聞いたので、運べるか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 差出人の話で持ち帰り方を見直したいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I planned to walk home with it after work. But the sender said it was a heavy box, so I am worried whether I can carry it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Indicate that the sender's information made you reconsider how to take it home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず票の番号で荷物の状況を確認します。差出人の話だけで、ここに届いている箱の大きさを決めることはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: First we will check the parcel's status using the notice number. The sender's description alone does not establish the size of the box delivered here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここにあると決めつけず、番号で確かめてください。重さと大きさがわかってから、受け取る方法を考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: その窓口にあることや寸法を推測しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please check the number rather than assuming it is here. I want to decide how to receive it after learning the weight and size.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not guess that it is at this counter or assume its dimensions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できる情報をご案内します。窓口へ来る方法を変えられるなら、車などでご本人が来られる日もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will provide information we can confirm. If you can change how you come to the counter, is there a day you yourself could come by car or similar transport?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族の車に乗せてもらい、私も一緒に来る日なら作れます。家族だけに頼むのではなく、自分で受け取る案です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族のみの代理受取りとは区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can arrange a day when a family member gives me a lift and I come too. The plan is to collect it myself, not send only my family member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish this from collection by a family member alone as a representative. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その場合も場所、時間、持参物を確認してください。再配達を希望する場合は、利用できる条件も調べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: In that case too, check the place, time and items to bring. If you want redelivery, let us also look up the available conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 車で来る案と再配達を比べたいです。車に箱が載るかも確かめるので、確認できた大きさを控えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車に載るか確認するため大きさを控える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to compare coming by car and redelivery. I will also check whether the box fits in the car, so I want to note its confirmed size.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Note the size to check whether it will fit in the car. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認内容をメモしてください。保管の案内も見て、別の日に来るだけでよいか、必要な連絡があるかを先にご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please note the confirmed details. Check the storage guidance too and ask in advance whether simply coming another day is enough or whether contact is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 所在と大きさと期限を確認します。車と再配達の条件を見て選び、別日にする場合の連絡もしてから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取日を変える前に必要条件を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the location, size and deadline. I will compare car collection and redelivery conditions, choose, and contact them about changing the day before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the necessary conditions before changing the collection day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 持ち帰りの方法まで考えられましたね。票の情報を保管し、無理に運ばず、お受取りの際はお気をつけてお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have considered how to take it home too. Keep the notice information and do not force yourself to carry it; please travel safely when you come to collect it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードが戻らなかったというご相談ですね。道で紛失したのではなく、機械の中に残ったと思われるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about a card that was not returned. Do you think it remained inside the machine, rather than being lost on the street?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ATMで操作したあと、カードが出ませんでした。落としたかは見ていませんが、機械から受け取っていないことは確かです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 外出中に落とした紛失と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: After I used the ATM, the card did not come out. I did not see whether I dropped it, but I am certain I did not receive it from the machine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Distinguish this from dropping and losing it while out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの機械を使ったかと、そのときの表示を教えてください。暗証番号を口頭で話す必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tell me which machine you used and what it displayed. You do not need to say your PIN aloud.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口に近い機械です。画面に係へ連絡という案内が出たので、時刻と機械の位置だけメモしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 暗証番号を話さず利用状況を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The machine near the entrance. The screen said to contact staff, so I only noted the time and machine location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the usage circumstances without stating your PIN. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当者へ状況を伝え、確認します。まだカードを回収できるかはお答えできませんので、その場で再操作しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will tell the staff and check. We cannot yet say whether the card can be recovered, so please do not try operating the machine again there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: カードが出るか試そうとはせず、案内の確認を待ちます。利用停止も必要か担当の方に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 取り出せると決めず担当への相談を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not test whether the card will come out; I will wait for the guidance to be checked. I also want to ask staff whether suspension is necessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose to consult staff without assuming it can be retrieved. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対象のカードと本人の確認を行って、対応をご案内します。持参されている本人確認の資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will verify the card concerned and your identity, then explain the response. Do you have identification documents with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 在留カードがあります。カード番号は覚えていませんが、機械の場所と利用時刻、受け取っていないことを説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 場所と時刻を使って対象確認を進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my residence card. I do not remember the card number, but I will describe the machine location, usage time and not having received it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Use the location and time to proceed with identifying the card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 覚えている情報と不明な情報を分けてお話しください。回収、停止、再発行のどの対応になるかは、確認した後に説明を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please distinguish remembered information from unknown information. After verification, hear the explanation about whether recovery, suspension or reissue applies.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: すぐ返してもらえると思わず、停止の受付が必要かも確かめます。再発行となる場合は、費用と受取り方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認後の受付内容に応じて対応を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not expect it to be returned immediately, and will check whether a suspension request is needed. If it is reissued, I will ask the fee and collection method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Understand the response according to the request handled after verification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 機械で起きたことを順に伝えていただけましたね。担当者の回答と受付内容をお確かめになってから、お帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have explained what happened at the machine in order. Please check the staff's answer and the details of your request before leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 瓶の商品をお持ちですね。袋の中で気づいたことがありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have brought a product in a jar. Did you notice something inside the bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰宅して袋を開けると、中身が少し漏れていました。瓶を開ける前だったので、ふたの状態を見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 瓶のふたの状態を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I opened the bag at home, some contents had leaked. It was before opening the jar, so I want the condition of the lid checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the condition of the jar lid to be checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 漏れたことを担当へ伝えます。持ち帰る間に落としたり、ふたを回して直したりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will tell staff about the leakage. Did you drop it while taking it home, or turn the lid to fix it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 落としていません。ふたも触らず、漏れた物を食べていません。袋に入れたまま持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持参までの扱いを具体的に知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I did not drop it. I did not touch the lid or eat the leaked contents. I brought it still in the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe specifically how it was handled before bringing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 状態を変えずに持参されたのですね。購入した時間と、レシートがあるかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You brought it without changing the condition. Please also tell me when you bought it and whether you have the receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日の昼に買い、このレシートが残っています。外の買い物袋は破れていませんが、瓶のふたの端が少しへこんで見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 破れない外袋とへこんだふたを混同しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I bought it at lunchtime today and still have this receipt. The outer shopping bag is not torn, but the edge of the jar lid looks slightly dented.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not confuse the intact outer bag with the dented lid. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋とふたの違いを含めて確認します。担当者が見るまで、ここで瓶を開けずにお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the difference between bag and lid too. Could you wait without opening the jar here until staff inspect it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 開けずに待ちます。交換を希望しますが、可能かは確認後に教えてください。返品の場合の案内も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認後の対応方法を条件付きで尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait without opening it. I would like an exchange, but please tell me whether that is possible after checking. I also want information about returns.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask conditionally about handling methods after verification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 購入状況と商品の確認後に、対応できる方法を説明します。この場で交換や安全性を断定することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking the purchase circumstances and product, we will explain what responses are possible. We cannot determine exchange eligibility or safety here on the spot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ふたを直せば食べられるとは考えず、担当の説明を待ちます。選べる方法と必要な物がわかったら、対応を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認された方法から次の対応を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not assume it is edible if I fix the lid; I will wait for the staff's explanation. Once I know the options and required items, I will decide what to do.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the next action from the confirmed options. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 袋と瓶の状態を分けて説明していただけましたね。担当の案内をお確かめになってから、お気をつけてお帰りくださいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have described the bag and jar conditions separately. Please check the staff's guidance, then take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鳥の写真に興味を持たれたのですね。撮影された場所まで歩きたいというご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are interested in the bird photograph. Would you like to walk to the place it was taken?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 写真と同じ鳥を見たいです。丘のほうへ行けば必ず見られると思いましたが、短い散歩にしたいとも思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遠い場所で必ず見られると思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to see the same bird. I thought I would definitely see it if I went towards the hill, but I also want a short walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you thought you would definitely see it at the distant location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 生き物なので、場所へ行っても見られるとは限りません。図では丘への経路は長めですから、歩きたい範囲も考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is a living creature, so visiting the place does not guarantee seeing it. The map shows a fairly long route to the hill, so also consider how far you want to walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 鳥を見るために遠くまで行くと決めないほうがよいのですね。近くで座って音を聞ける所も探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 生き物を見るため無理に長距離へ進まない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I should not decide to go far just to see the bird. I would also like to find somewhere nearby to sit and listen to the sounds.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not push on a long distance just to see wildlife. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 図には入口に近い林の休憩所があります。そこで過ごして戻る案なら、丘を目指すより短い経路にできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The map has a rest area in the woods near the entrance. Spending time there and returning would give you a shorter route than heading to the hill.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その林までにします。鳥がいなくても散歩と休憩を楽しみたいので、見つかるまで待ち続けるつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鳥がいなくても短い散歩を楽しむ目的にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will go only as far as those woods. I want to enjoy walking and resting even if there are no birds, so I will not keep waiting until one appears.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Make enjoying a short walk the goal even without birds. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 過ごす目的を変えられましたね。戻る道と休む時間も、先に考えておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You have adjusted your purpose. Let us also plan the return path and rest time beforehand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 休憩も含めて三十分くらいにします。来た道で入口へ戻れるよう、林と入口の位置を図で覚えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 林と入口の位置を先に覚える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: About thirty minutes including the rest. I will learn the woods and entrance positions on the map so I can return to the entrance along the same path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Learn the positions of the woods and entrance beforehand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 実際の案内や路面も見てください。近い所でも歩いて疲れた場合は、写真の場所へ先に進まず、引き返す案で構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the actual signs and path surface too. Even nearby, if you tire while walking, it is fine to turn back rather than continuing towards the photo location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 疲れたら林まで行かずに戻ります。鳥の有無より、自分が歩ける範囲で短く散歩することを優先します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 鳥を探すより歩ける短い範囲を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: If I tire, I will return without reaching the woods. I will prioritize a short walk within my ability over whether birds are there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prioritize a short manageable range over searching for birds. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 写真だけに合わせず過ごし方を選べましたね。木々の様子や音も味わって、よい散歩の時間をお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40228-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have chosen how to spend your time without relying only on the photograph. Enjoy the trees and sounds too, and have a lovely walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 往復の切符をお考えですか。帰りも同じ経路を通られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you considering a return ticket? Will you use the same route back?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じつもりでしたが、帰りは途中で知人に会う約束があります。その駅で降りてから帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰りに知人の駅で降りてから帰宅したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: That was my intention, but I have arranged to meet an acquaintance partway home. I want to get off at that station before returning home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to get off at your acquaintance's station on the return journey before going home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 降りる予定の駅も含めて経路を確認しましょう。行きと帰りを別々に書けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the route including the station where you plan to get off. Can you draw the outward and return routes separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 行きは目的の駅まで、帰りは知人の駅に寄る線を書きます。単純な往復とは違うかもしれませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 行きの直行と帰りの立寄りを別の線にして単純往復との違いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will draw the outward route to my destination station and the return route stopping at the acquaintance's station. It may differ from a simple round trip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Draw separate lines for the direct outward trip and return stop, showing the difference from a simple round trip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切符の扱いは経路と利用する列車で確認が必要です。途中で降りる日は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ticket handling needs checking for the route and trains used. Have you decided the day of the intermediate stop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 帰る日の午後です。知人と会う時間は未定なので、時刻が決まっていないことも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰宅日の午後に寄るが会う時刻は未定だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The afternoon of the day I return. The meeting time is undecided, so I will explain that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will stop in the afternoon of your return day, but the meeting time is undecided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その条件で選べる方法を調べましょう。購入の前に、経路以外に確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us look up the options available under those conditions. Besides the route, is there anything you want to check before buying?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 途中で降りてまた乗る場合の条件と、分けて買う場合の費用を比較したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 途中下車して再乗車する条件と別購入の費用を比較したいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to compare the conditions for getting off and boarding again with the cost of buying separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to compare stopover and reboarding conditions with the cost of separate purchases. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 条件を確かめてから総額でご案内します。知人との予定は、先に確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will confirm the conditions and explain the total price. Will you check your plans with your acquaintance first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。経路のメモを見せて会う駅を確かめ、必要な条件が分かるまでは購入を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 知人へ経路メモを示して駅を確認し条件判明まで購入を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will show the route notes to confirm the meeting station, and wait to buy until I understand the necessary conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show your acquaintance the route notes, confirm the station and wait to buy until the conditions are known. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、行きと帰りの図を見ながら確認しましょう。ご予定がまとまりましたら、よいご旅行を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us check while looking at the outward and return diagrams. Once your plans are settled, have a good trip.
